model_id_confirmed_via: response.body.model field in every batch output record, verified identical to the requested id

prompts.reuse_method: imported directly, not retyped, not restructured for caching

pilot_sample: pilot_sample.json (4 proteins, 1 per organism, seed=42, selected before any OpenAI call existed for this pilot)

batch_api_feasibility.result: SUPPORTED -- completed in ~3 minutes for a 2-request test batch with this exact model+reasoning_effort+max_completion_tokens combination before the real 48-call pilot batches were submitted

prompt_caching.result: NOT ENGAGED in either configuration -- cached_tokens=0 for all 96 pilot calls combined. Root cause: prompt lengths (mean 265 tokens, all well under OpenAI's ~1024-token minimum for caching to activate at all) are too short for caching to apply, regardless of repeated identical structure. This is a property of the (unmodified) frozen prompt construction, not a configuration mistake -- reported as a limitation, not solved by altering the scientific prompt content.

reasoning_effort_support.result: SUPPORTED -- both 'low' and 'medium' accepted by the API without error, confirmed on both a trivial probe and a real scientific prompt before committing to the 48-call batches.
